text_block_list.text:
It's the morning after a day off, and I
spot
Mayano Top Gun. I call out her
name, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Stop it! Close your eyes! Don't look this
way!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Urgh... I was practicing putting on makeup yesterday, and before I knew it, the sun was already up...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: My eyes are so dark I look like a panda!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Waaah! You're not allowed to see me
like this!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Seems like she didn't get enough rest on
her day
off...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
